title: Scout or module crash, freeze, or mission won't start
sourceDocs: Dev & Bring-Up BOLOs (reviewed 11/6/2026), in the Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide

si_what.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Module Crash; Scout Crash; Unable to Start Mission

options.label: A module shows red failed or stopped in Scout
Scout is frozen: map and lidar don't update

si_mod.text: Restart the crashed module in Scout
steps: If you're on the road, do a !pullover first.
Restart the crashed module in Scout.
si_mod.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Module Crash

si_mod_cs.text: Collect a sysreport, then cold start
steps: Make sure the vehicle is immobilized.
Generate a sysreport from the Scout UI.
Run the cold start steps for your platform: !coldstart (a579m), !volvocoldstart (asvat) or !a2cs (LTS).
si_mod_cs.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Module Crash
si_mod_cs.help: If the mission was started in the Aurora Mobile App, RA moves the vehicle back to the AUTONOMOUS stack after it's back on.

steps: Make sure the vehicle is immobilized.
Generate a sysreport from the Scout UI.
Run the !coldstart steps.
Make sure the vehicle is immobilized.
Generate a sysreport from the Scout UI.
Run the !volvocoldstart steps.
Make sure the vehicle is immobilized.
Generate a sysreport from the Scout UI.
Run the !a2cs steps.

si_crash.text: Give Scout 90 seconds, then restart it
steps: If you can, collect a sysreport.
Wait 90 seconds to see if Scout recovers on its own.
If it doesn't, close and restart Scout.
si_crash.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Scout Crash

si_freeze.text: Check the Scout version and update it
steps: Open a terminal (Ctrl + Alt + T) and run: dpkg -l aurora-perseus-rsi
If the Scout version is older than 9.10.2026, update it by running: sudo apt update && sudo apt -y install aurora-perseus-rsi
This works from the RSI user profile. You may be asked for the password.
si_freeze.help: Temporary BOLO for Perseus trucks (the RSI laptop), last reviewed 11/6/2026. Some dev testing installs a modified Scout that doesn't always get reverted afterwards. The BOLO's contact if it keeps freezing is Brian Witt (@bwitt).

si_start.text: Check drives and ticket number, then reload Scout
steps: Check the logging drives are inserted and not full. The pre-mission pre-checks (preflight) show the percentage of logging space used.
Make sure the mission information (VO ticket number) is entered correctly.
Reload Scout: close it and relaunch.
Try to start the mission again.
si_start.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Unable to Start Mission

si_forvis.text: Working again without VRE. Post a /vreforvis with the steps you took, a sysreport if possible, and how long you spent troubleshooting.
si_forvis.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Purpose

details: Screenshot: the failed module or the error in Scout.
si_esc.text: Still not working. Escalate to VRE in a #vops_troubleshooting thread (Scout Troubleshooter, Aurora Mobile App, or /vrehelp) and paste the handoff.
si_esc.source: Dev Ops Troubleshooting Guide v2.2 (Oct 21, 2026), Purpose
